## Problem and change

Describe the concrete trigger and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List commands and actual outcomes. For evaluations include sample count, configuration and limitations.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Behavior changes have meaningful tests.
- [ ] Documentation and tool/API contracts are consistent.
- [ ] Data is original or properly licensed; no secrets/private information.
- [ ] Metrics distinguish demo regression from held-out business results.
